met_analysis:
The Well-Marked Low Pressure Area over Gangetic West Bengal and adjoining areas of north coastal Odisha & northwest Bay of Bengal now lies over Gangetic West Bengal and adjoining areas of north coastal Odisha, Jharkhand & northwest Bay of Bengal at 0830 IST of today, the 01st September, 2026. The associated cyclonic circulation extends upto 7.6 km above mean sea level tilting southwest with height. It is likely to move west-northwestwards across north Odisha and Jharkhand during next 48 hours.
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level now passes through Jammu, Chandigarh, Shahjahanpur, Varanasi, centre of Well Marked Low Pressure Area over Gangetic West Bengal and adjoining areas of north coastal Odisha, Jharkhand & northwest Bay of Bengal and thence southeastwards to Eastcentral Bay of Bengal.
The trough now runs fromt he cyclonic circulation associated with Well Marked Low Pressure Area over Gangetic West Bengal and adjoining areas of north Odisha, Jharkhand & northwest Bay of Bengal to northwest Uttar Pradesh across Jharkhand and Bihar and extends upto 4.5 km above mean sea level.
The trough now runs from south Gujrat to the cyclonic circulation associated with Well Marked Low Pressure Area over Gangetic West Bengal and adjoining areas of north Odisha, Jharkhand & northwest Bay of Bengal across Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh at 5.8 Km above mean sea level.
The Western Disturbance as a cyclonic circulation over north Pakistan & adjoining Jammu Division persists and now seen at 7.6 km above mean sea level.
